chats.answer:
For reverse engineering mechanical parts into CAD models, my top recommendations are SHINING 3D FreeScan Combo+, Creaform HandySCAN 3D, and SHINING 3D EinScan Rigil.

The best choice depends on whether you're scanning parts for dimensional accuracy, CNC machining, 3D printing, or simply recreating their geometry.

One important distinction: a good 3D scanner isn't necessarily a good reverse-engineering solution. You also need software that can turn scanned meshes into editable CAD geometry (STEP, IGES, or parametric solids).
